values.note: Huron County Parks: electric only $42 a night, lakefront electric $45, full hookup $50 (the Checkfront engine quotes the same for Tue June 8, 2027); +$5 on holidays, $5 off in the off season; one rate for everyone. Rustic tent-only sites $31, cabins $87. Seasonal full-hookup site $2,800. Cancelling costs $15 and is refunded as a gift card, and only 30+ days out.

fees.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/wagener-county-park (Camping Rates: 'Full Hookup $50 per night + $5 Holidays -$5 Off Season Discount', 'Electric Only $42', 'Electric Only Lakeview $45', 'Rustic $31', 'Seasonal $2,800 Full Hookup') + Checkfront inventory for 2027-06-08 ('Wagener Electric Only ... $42.00 per night', 'Wagener Lakefront Electric Only ... $45.00', 'Wagener Full Hookup ... $50.00', 'Wagener Rustic #201 (Tent Only) $31.00'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: Checkfront inventory, read 2026-10-25: 'Wagener Full Hookup' #101-105 (30 amps), 55 'Electric Only' sites (30 amps), 15 'Lakefront Electric Only' sites, one of them (#22) 'Power: 50 amps'

values.note: 75 RV sites on the booking engine (5 full hookup, 55 electric only, 15 lakefront electric), each 'recommended for camping units under' 25 to 55 ft; the lakefront sites 21-28 are pull-through and take units under 55 ft. Plus 8 rustic tent-only sites and 8 rustic cabins. One camping unit per site; no tents on full-hookup sites.

sites.source: Checkfront inventory, read 2026-10-25 (per-site 'Site Dimensions', 'Recommended for camping units under N ft in length', 'This site is a pull-through site', 'Rustic #201-209 (Tent Only)') + https://huroncountyparks.com/wagener-county-park FAQ ('Only 1 camping unit is allowed per campsite')

season.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/wagener-county-park ('Enjoy Camping at Wagener County Park Open May 1 - October 15'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://huroncountyparks.com/wagener-county-park FAQ ('Bath houses with free showers and flush toilets are available', 'There is no Wi-Fi at the park'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked online through Huron County Parks' Checkfront engine on the park's reservations page. Next year's sites open to the general public about December 1 ('2027 Reservations Open to the General Public on Tues., Dec. 1 at 12pm (Noon) EST'). Check-in 3pm, check-out 1pm. Phone bookings (888) 265-2583, 10am-6:30pm.

note: Huron County park on Lake Huron, 5 mi S of Harbor Beach (2671 S Lakeshore Rd), 132 wooded acres. Rocky beach, not ideal for swimming; hiking trails, playgrounds; 8 rustic cabins. The boat launch is unavailable (county page, read 2026-10-25). --Claude
summary: County page + Checkfront engine (June 2027 quote): confirmed fees $42 electric to $50 full hookup, season May 1-Oct 15, water/sewer; added 50 A (one lakefront site), 75 RV sites to 55 ft with pull-throughs (count 96 -> 83 incl. 8 tent-only rustic sites; cabins excluded), showers/flush toilets/no Wi-Fi, booking via Checkfront opening Dec 1. Note trimmed of prices/counts/booking/season and of the boat launch, which the county says is unavailable. Seasonal share small: 75 sites sold nightly online, seasonals limited to some full-hookup sites.
